name: @bpmsoft-agent/desktop
description: BPMSoft AI Agent — Electron desktop shell
author: bpmsoft-agent

scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:node && npm run typecheck:web
scripts.dist:mac: npm run build && node ../../scripts/fetch-platform-packages.mjs darwin arm64 darwin x64 && electron-builder --mac --arm64 --x64 --publish never
scripts.dist:win: npm run build && node ../../scripts/fetch-platform-packages.mjs win32 x64 && electron-builder --win --x64 --publish never
